parameters.query: SELECT c.id AS channel_id, c.tenant_id, c.channel_type, c.provider, c.external_id, c.credential_ref, c.adapter_secret, c.active, t.status AS tenant_status, t.sector_code FROM channels c JOIN tenants t ON t.id = c.tenant_id WHERE c.provider = 'telegram' AND c.external_id = 'hazaa_clinc_bot' AND c.active = true LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Resolve Channel
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Tenant comes ONLY from the channels row (provider + external_id). A client-supplied tenant_id in the payload is ignored by design. If no row returns, the Contract node rejects and the Gate node throws loudly after logging — the message never reaches the brain.

nodes.name: Build Contract
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Contract only. Role defaults to customer (see TBD-T1). No provider secret, no token, no raw payload forwarded.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO admin_audit (tenant_id, action, target, details) SELECT '{{ $json.contract.tenant_id }}', 'channel_message_rejected', 'telegram', '{"channel_id": "{{ $json.channel_id }}"}'::jsonb WHERE '{{ $json.status }}' = 'rejected';

nodes.name: Log Rejection (guarded)
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Rejections are logged even though they never reach the brain. Approved messages write nothing here. (tenant_id is null for an unregistered channel — that row is still a useful rejection record; the brain never sees it.)

nodes.name: Gate Rejected Messages
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Loud failure is the rejection mechanism: the workflow errors here for rejected messages so nothing downstream runs. Configure the workflow error path/alert at import (TBD-T2).

nodes.name: Call Brain
nodes.notes: DRAFT. Calls barqlo-brain-main with the contract only. PUT_N8N_WEBHOOK_BASE is set at import to either the production webhook base (…/webhook) or the test base (…/webhook-test) — that prefix decision is TBD per WIRING_CHECKLIST item 1; do not guess it in this draft.

nodes.name: Send Reply Telegram
nodes.notes: DRAFT. TBD-T4 (do not guess): with one generic webhook, the Send node's credential is static, but different bots need different credentials. Options: (a) one adapter instance per bot with its own static credential, or (b) a runtime credential-resolution send step. This draft uses placeholder credential PUT_TELEGRAM_BOT_CREDENTIAL and must not be imported for multiple bots until TBD-T4 is decided. Private-DM assumption: channel_user_id is the chat id for a 1:1 DM; group chats are TBD.

parameters.text: عذرًا، حصلت مشكلة مؤقتة، وجارٍ تحويل استفسارك للمالك.
